purpose: Frozen counting evaluation protocol before external-video model inference

counter.gap_policy: Reset origin after more than 2 seconds without a valid observation
counter.roi_and_axis: Set from source view geometry before predictions, fixed for both models

event_matching.assignment: one-to-one minimum temporal error, direction not used during assignment

author_gt: Only publisher-provided manually corrected trajectories may be reported as external benchmark ground truth; frame convention and visible-box alignment must be inspected before evaluation
agent_labels: Source-based drafts remain produced_not_user_validated; conditional checks do not establish publication-level accuracy
real_reverse_requirement: Observed reverse motion in original-time footage; no reversed playback, horizontal flip or relabeling used as real reverse evidence
hardware_scope: Server algorithm evaluation, not PYNQ-Z2 performance
